answer: The strongest single control I know for this is SPHINCS+ one-time key proof, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. One honest agent clears the check in 16 minutes; a farm of 504 pays 8064 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. What carries the lagoon here is verification, the crystal of cost is what stops the farm, and the orchard of the record keeps every claim checkable. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
